description: Email service definitions with host and verification metadata

hosts.description: List of domain hostnames for this service

old_hosts.description: List of outdated/discontinued domain hostnames for this service

costs.description: Pricing classification of the service itself

type.description: Service category: mailbox = real mailbox provider (webmail/IMAP storage); forwarding = alias/forwarding only (always strict-tier for consumers); isp = ISP/carrier-bundled mailbox; hosting = custom-domain/business email hosting; reserved = special-use names

oneOf.description: Verification method required during signup. 'none' and 'email' still allow anonymous use (strict-tier for consumers); mobile/phone/sms/payment/other verify identity (whitelist-tier). Unset = unknown, treated as verified.
Verification methods required during signup; anonymous use possible if 'none' or 'email' is present

mx_hosts.description: List of MX (mail exchange) hostnames for the service

jurisdiction.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country of the provider's legal seat (from imprint/terms/operator info); absent = unknown

hosted.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country where the provider's service site resolves (GeoIP of its web host); absent = unknown

cloud.description: Cloud/CDN operator hosting the provider's service site (from ASN), e.g. Cloudflare, AWS, Azure, Google Cloud; absent = self-hosted/ISP/unknown

discontinued.description: Whether the email service has been discontinued; discontinued services are excluded from whitelist and strict-tier classification entirely
